lesson.title: Review Day: Letters, Colors, and Numbers
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: This week you learned five new letters, three colors, and five numbers! Let's review it all.

Say the five new letters in order: ਟ, ਠ, ਡ, ਢ, ਣ. Say the three colors: ਲਾਲ, ਪੀਲਾ, ਨੀਲਾ. Count from one to five: ਇੱਕ, ਦੋ, ਤਿੰਨ, ਚਾਰ, ਪੰਜ. Now combine a color and a number of your own choosing, and say the phrase out loud.
Wonderful work these past two weeks! You've learned real, useful Punjabi vocabulary alongside continuing the alphabet — genuine progress toward reading and speaking.

objectives: Recite this week's five letters, three colors, and five numbers
Create and read a new number-color combination
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Recite this week's letters, colors, and numbers together, in order.
2. Have the child create and read their own new number-color phrase.
3. Complete the review worksheet.
4. Celebrate finishing two full weeks — real vocabulary progress alongside the alphabet!
differentiationTips: Struggling: break the recitation into three separate chunks (letters, colors, numbers) rather than one long unbroken sequence
Ready for more: ask the child to also recall one word from last week (a greeting or family word) and combine it into a longer phrase if possible
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the three vocabulary sets (letters, colors, or numbers) needs the most repetition
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a recitation and creative-combination review — check that the child can recall this week's letters, colors, and numbers, and create one new valid phrase.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's alphabet continuation and new vocabulary (colors, numbers) before the course continues, matching the 'consolidate before adding more' pacing established across this session.

generationData.instructions: Trace each item one more time, and say it out loud.
